description: This file defines an Angular component called TreeNodeComponent, which manages the visualization and interaction logic for a tree node within a hierarchical viewer. It handles displaying expand/collapse controls, icons, and node data views, as well as emitting events for user interactions such as toggling the tree or pinning nodes.

classes.name: TreeNodeComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that renders a tree node with controls for expanding/collapsing, pinning, and displaying node data.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates CSS classes when input properties change.

methods.name: isPropertiesTreeNode
methods.description: Determines if the current node is of properties type based on its class.

methods.name: showPinNodeIcon
methods.description: Decides whether to show the pin/unpin icon based on node type and parent status.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Handles toggling expand/collapse state of the node.

methods.name: showChevron
methods.description: Determines if the expand/collapse chevron should be displayed.

methods.name: showLeafNodeIcon
methods.description: Decides if the leaf node icon should be shown.

methods.name: pinNode
methods.description: Handles pinning or unpinning a node.

methods.name: updateCollapseDiffClass
methods.description: Updates CSS class based on differences among child nodes.

methods.name: getAllDiffTypesOfChildren
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all diff types present among child nodes.
